body:
PyPI currently does not appear to provide win_arm64 wheels for temporalio package.

Is Windows ARM64 intentionally unsupported, or has support simply not
been added to the release pipeline yet?

Would a PR enabling win_arm64 wheel publication be accepted?

Thanks.

comments.body: Just an update that I was not able to build a whl locally and got hit by some build failures.
We don't have official windows arm64 support. If there are some changes we can make to support your local build, we wouldn't mind accepting those if they don't have major implications.

title: Windows ARM64 wheel support
